ad.ui.add.contact_starts.eye_touch.tip: Closes an eye slowly as a finger comes near it.
ad.ui.add.contact_starts.nose_boop.tip: Opens the mouth slowly as a finger nears the nose.
ad.ui.welcome.title: Let's get your first item onto the menu.
ad.ui.welcome.toggle.desc: Opens the avatar object picker. The chosen object becomes a toggle, the same as dropping it.
ad.ui.welcome.toggle.tip: Picks an object on the avatar and turns it into a toggle.
ad.ui.welcome.convert.title: Convert from VRCFury or Modular Avatar
ad.ui.welcome.convert.tip: Opens the window that converts what another tool would install here.
ad.ui.welcome.outfit.tip: Opens the wizard that builds a whole outfit selector from objects at once.
ad.ui.welcome.quickstart.tip: Opens the package's own quick start guide.
ad.ui.row.move.tip: Moves this row into another submenu or the root menu.
ad.ui.row.duplicate.tip: Adds a copy of this row right after it.
ad.ui.row.delete.tip: Removes this row and its own targets.
ad.ui.row.convert.tip: Brings this item into this component so it can be edited here.
ad.ui.row.rename.tip: Puts the focus on this row's own name field.
ad.ui.add.contact.tip: Adds a ready made contact start: Headpat, Eye touch or Nose boop.
ad.ui.capture_missing.tip: Renders an icon for every entry of this component that has none yet.
ad.ui.tagfilter.tip: Narrows the tree to rows that match the ticked tags.
ad.ui.tagfilter.chip.remove.tip: Removes this one tag from the filter.
ad.ui.advanced_fold.tip: Shows the platform, parameter, Saved, Synced and blend time settings this panel tucks away by default.
ad.ui.advanced_fold.dot.tip: One of the settings this fold hides is not at its default.
ad.ui.add_effect.tip: Adds a section for another kind of effect this control can have.
ad.ui.tips_switch.tip: Turns every dismissed first-use tip back on.
ad.info.drag_needs_no_search_or_tags: Clear the search and the tag filters to move rows.
ad.info.drag_needs_no_tags: Clear the tag filters to move rows.
ad.tip.toggle: A toggle switches its targets on or off from the menu. Drag an object onto the tree, or add an effect below, to give it something to switch.
ad.tip.radial: A radial blends its targets between two ends as its slider moves, instead of switching them on or off. Add a blend shape below and set what its low and high ends look like.
ad.tip.submenu: A submenu groups other entries under one menu button. Drag entries into it, or add new ones while it is selected, to fill it.
ad.tip.trigger: A trigger fires its effects on its own, from a toggle, a parameter, a touch or a blend shape, without taking a menu slot of its own. Pick what starts it below.
ad.tip.override: An override holds a blend shape at one value in every animation that already uses it, so nothing else can fight it. Add the shape it should hold below.
ad.tip.preset: A preset puts several other controls into one state with a single button. Add the states it should set below.
ad.tip.grabbable: A grabbable lets a creator pick up and hold an object in a hand. Pick the object and which hand or hands below.
ad.tip.animator: A merged animator brings an existing controller's layers straight into the build, unchanged. Pick the controller below.
ad.tip.menu_asset: An installed menu asset brings a finished menu asset into the build as it already is. Pick the asset above.
ad.tip.header: This header holds the component's own install settings and the avatar's shared memory bar. Add your first entry in the tree below to get started.
ad.tip.header.simple: This header shows whether the avatar is ready to upload and how much of VRChat's memory the menu uses. Add your first entry in the tree below to get started.
ad.ui.mode.tip: Simple shows only what most avatars need; Advanced shows every tool. Nothing you made is hidden.
ad.ui.advanced_item.note: This is an advanced item; switch to Advanced to add more like it.
ad.warn.link_clips_outside_fx: "{0}" follows {1}, but that shape also moves in {2}, outside the FX layer, where the trigger cannot see it. Move that animation into the FX layer if the trigger should react to it there.
ad.warn.link_source_tracked: "{0}" follows {1}, which VRChat moves itself for blinking or lip sync outside every animation, so the trigger never sees it move. Pick a shape your own animations move instead. ({2})
ad.warn.smooth_range: "{0}" starts at {1} but is fully on at {2}, which is not above it, so it is fully on just above Starts at instead. Set Fully on at higher than Starts at. ({3})
ad.warn.requirements_one_card: "{0}" reads only the card its shape is in, so the conditions in its other cards are kept but not used. Move what you need into the first card with + And, or remove the other cards. ({1})
ad.ui.trigger.style.tip: Smooth blends the effects in as the shape moves; Switch turns them fully on at one weight.
ad.ui.trigger.style.smooth.tip: The effects blend in from Starts at to Fully on at as the shape moves.
ad.ui.trigger.style.switch.tip: The effects switch fully on once the shape reaches Switch at.
ad.ui.trigger.smooth_start.tip: The shape weight at which the effects start to come in.
ad.ui.trigger.smooth_full.tip: The shape weight at which the effects are fully on.
ad.ui.trigger.switch_at.tip: The shape weight at which the whole trigger switches on.
ad.ui.trigger.swap_at.tip: The shape weight at which objects switch and materials swap, since those cannot blend.
ad.ui.when.add_requirement.tip: Adds a requirement: while any requirement fails, the effects rest.
ad.ui.when.add_and.limit_driver.tip: This card holds at most {0} rows, its first row included.
ad.ui.when.requirements_note: Each + And adds a requirement. While any requirement fails, the effects rest; while all hold, the first row moves them.
ad.ui.preview.unchecked: The preview cannot check a parameter, contact or PhysBone requirement, so it counts those as met.
ad.ui.builds.mirror: a hidden copy of the shape's weight, no synced bits
ad.summary.parameters.mirror: a hidden copy of a blend shape's weight, never synced
ad.warn.link_no_fx_clip: No animation in the FX layer moves {1}, so "{0}" cannot follow that shape and its effects stay where the shape rests. Animate {1} in an FX animation, or pick a shape one already moves.
ad.ui.when.ignored.tip: A blend shape trigger reads only its first card, so this card is kept for you to move or remove what it holds.
ad.ui.builds.pauses_blink_shape: Blinking pauses while the effects are on
ad.ui.builds.pauses_lipsync_shape: Lip sync pauses while the effects are on
ad.ui.language.tip: The language AvatarDoc is shown in, shared with Modular Avatar and NDMF.
ad.summary.parameters.name: Name
ad.ui.pick.search.tip: Type to filter the list. Up and Down move through the results, Enter picks the highlighted one, Escape clears the search.
ad.ui.pick.more: {0} more. Type more letters to narrow the list.
ad.ui.pick.more.one: {0} more. Type more letters to narrow the list.
